findings: Planar DISSOLVE invalidates non-manifold edge join candidates and rechecks manifoldness before joining; adjacent manifold edges may still dissolve.
Subsequent degree-two vertex cleanup can affect junction-adjacent topology even with dissolve_boundaries disabled.
NORMAL delimiter protects winding discontinuities; there is no learned-colour delimiter. Actual interpolated colour error must be measured.
Planar polygon counts do not measure triangle reduction. This candidate uses actual calc_loop_triangles tessellation.
